notes.title: Patch 1.0.7.5
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.7.5

Arabic Patch Notes: https://www.abokhashem.com/patchnotes-ar

This patch has been up for a few days, here are the notes:

- Major improvements to user interface. Much more friendly with a controller.

- All texts and icons are now made to be easily seen from a distance.

- Removed being randomly chased by cops.

- Tutorials are shortened and simplified.

- Dialogue options turn grey when they have been exhausted.

- Nascar achievement time limit increased to 1:46 (although the descripition isn't updated yet)

- Prompts now differentiate between inventory and trash inventory.

- Collider improvements in dungeons.

- Updated the HUD in the tutorial.

- For convenience, most buttons now shoot in Shukman's Minigame on controller.

- A few minor bug fixes.

- A few typos in the quest descriptions.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6.2
notes.notes:
Arabic Patch Notes: https://www.abokhashem.com/patchnotes-ar

The following changes and fixes have been made:

- Major improvements to vehicles and driving, as well as making drifitng easier to accomplish.

- Improved jumping with Abo Khashem and Shukman.

- Changed Arabic font and improved its size and visibility.

- Fixed an issue that made Mr. Whiskerkins disappear after dying to him in the skyscraper.

- Fixed an issue that caused multiple Monsterkins to spawn for some players in the final battle.

- Dungeon HUD icons are now affected by Safe Frame.

- Safe Frame is now enabled by default (PS4).

- Fixed an issue that caused elements of the ending cutscene to persist after cutscene.

- Added subtext that explains each difficulty.

- Weapons now are automatically hidden when players engage in dialogue.

- Changes the Two-Handed weapon starting combo.

- Slight improvement to the Business Simulator controls.

- Removed the ability to have two combos and alternate between them. Players now only have access to one    combo. This was done to remove confusion.

- Fixed an issue that allowed some players to go through the Shukman mini-game tutorial without being in the    minigame.

- Improved some quest hints and markers to better explain the next objective.

- Fixed an issue that allowed some players to exploit some boss fights.

- Fixed an issue that allowed some players to exit the bank during the bank quest.

- Fixed an issue that caused some players to get stuck on the quest where you get the Sons of Adam vehicle.

- Collision improvements in Mr. Whiskerkin's Watchtower dungeon.

- Fixed an issue that caused players to get stuck on the "sleep in your bed" quest.

- Fixed an issue that prevented people from unlocking the "Investor" achievement when playing in Arabic.

- Fixed an issue that caused mouse to be unresponsive when dying while in first person in dungeons.

- Multiple other small fixes to some reported issues.
